pr_metadata.title: Allow to not optimize release build
pr_metadata.description:
Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/2457

This will allow to speedup compilation for people, that want to test Godot without `DEBUG_ENABLED` flag

If fix is good, then I will do the same for others platform

gold_comments.issue_summary:
```suggestion
        elif env["optimize"] == "size":  # optimize for size
```
No optimization flags are going to be applied with `none` as it won't be handled.
gold_comments.evidence_requirement: The code must handle `env['optimize'] == 'none'` for release builds; currently no optimization flag is applied when 'none' is selected, which may cause unintended behavior.
gold_comments.rationale: A release build with `optimize='none'` would silently skip optimization flags, potentially leading to poor performance or unexpected behavior in production.
